answer:
Yes. CBI Q&A 1088 permits listed ETF and unlisted classes to coexist in the same fund, subject to clear prospectus disclosure.

The prospectus should compare how investors deal (including whether they transact on-exchange or directly with the fund), settlement arrangements, and associated costs and minimum investment/holding amounts. It should explain any differences in class rights, liquidity, and pricing—including that listed shares trade at market prices that may differ from NAV, while unlisted shares are dealt at the applicable NAV-based price.

These are Irish CBI disclosure considerations; US share-class exemptive conditions do not apply.
